summary: Spencer Veysey was reported overdue at 10:30 p.m. October 2 after a planned Longs Peak summit; rangers found his body October 3 at the bottom of Lambs Slide and flew it out October 4
location: Lambs Slide, Longs Peak, Rocky Mountain National Park
notes: Exact time and cause of death not stated in the NPS release; county not verified. Type recorded as other pending more detail.
